events.text: Carles Puigdemont i Casamajó was born.
events.subject: self
events.quote: born 29 December 1962

events.text: He has served as a Member of the European Parliament.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Since 2019 he has served as a Member of the European Parliament

events.text: Puigdemont served as the 130th President of Catalonia.
events.subject: self
events.quote: served as the 130th President of Catalonia from 2016

events.text: He was removed from office by the Spanish Government.
events.subject: self
events.quote: from 2016 to 2017 when he was removed from office by the Spanish Government

events.text: He became a journalist.
events.subject: self
events.quote: he became a journalist in 1982

events.text: He was director of the Catalan News Agency.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was director of the Catalan News Agency from 1999

events.text: His directorship of the Catalan News Agency ended.
events.subject: self
events.quote: from 1999 to 2002

events.text: He has been director of Gironas House of Culture.
events.subject: self
events.quote: has been director of Gironas House of Culture since 2002

events.text: He joined the Democratic Convergence of Catalonia (CDC).
events.subject: self
events.quote: joining the nationalist Democratic Convergence of Catalonia ( CDC ) , the predecessor to the PDeCAT , in 1980

events.text: He gave up journalism to pursue a career in politics.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He gave up journalism to pursue a career in politics in 2006

events.text: He was elected as a member of the Parliament of Catalonia for the constituency of Girona.
events.subject: self
events.quote: he was elected as a member of the Parliament of Catalonia for the constituency of Girona

events.text: He was elected to the Municipality Council of Girona.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was elected to the Municipality Council of Girona in 2007

events.text: He became Mayor of Girona.
events.subject: self
events.quote: in 2011 he became Mayor of Girona

events.text: The Parliament of Catalonia elected Puigdemont as the 130th President of the Government of Catalonia.
events.subject: self
events.object: President of the Government of Catalonia
events.quote: On 10 January 2016 , the Parliament of Catalonia elected Puigdemont as the 130th President of the Government of Catalonia

events.text: He approved laws for permitting an independence referendum.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 6–7 September 2017 , he approved laws for permitting an independence referendum

events.text: The Catalan independence referendum was held in Catalonia.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 1 October 2017 , the Catalan independence referendum was held in Catalonia

events.text: The Catalan Parliament declared independence.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The Catalan Parliament declared independence on 27 October 2017

events.text: Charges of rebellion, sedition and misuse of public funds were brought against Puigdemont and other members of the Puigdemont Government.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 30 October 2017 charges of rebellion , sedition and misuse of public funds were brought against Puigdemont

events.text: Puigdemont was re-elected to Parliament at the regional elections.
events.subject: self
events.quote: At the regional elections held on 21 December 2017 Puigdemont was re-elected to Parliament

events.text: He was detained by the Autobahnpolizei acting on his European Arrest Warrant in Schleswig-Holstein.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 25 March 2018 , he was detained by the Autobahnpolizei ( highway patrol ) acting on his European Arrest Warrant in the northern German state of Schleswig-Holstein
